premise: It's Starfish's birthday: Crab brings the music, Octopus the dancing, and little Shrimp, who brought nothing, is told she is the best present of all.
inspiration: The gift-giving folk tale (the poorest guest's gift) turned simple: being there is the gift.
lesson: Your friends want you, not your presents.

en-US.title: The Pool Party
en-US.text: [excited] It was {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Starfish's birthday, and everyone came to the pool for a party! {starfish:face happy} {starfish:live jump} {crab:enter} {crab:go to pool} Crab brought the music. {crab:face happy} {sfx:clicks} Click-clack, click-clack went his claws. {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to pool} Octopus brought the dancing. With eight arms, {octopus:face happy} {octopus:live dance} he could dance with EVERYONE at once! And {shrimp:enter} {shrimp:go to pool} Shrimp brought… nothing at all. {shrimp:face sad} [nervously] I didn't bring a present, she whispered. [short pause] {starfish:live wave} Starfish waved all five arms. [warmly] You're here, said Starfish. That's the best present. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:spin} So Shrimp twirled, round and round, the twirliest dancer of all. {canvas:confetti 0.8 12s} [happily] Hooray! {crab:live dance} Crab clicked and danced. {octopus:live hug} Octopus hugged everyone at once. {starfish:sparkle} And Starfish had the happiest birthday a starfish ever had.

[warmly] Has venido, dijo Estrella. Ese es el mejor regalo. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:spin} Así que Gamba dio vueltas y más vueltas, la bailarina más giratoria de todas. {canvas:confetti 0.8 12s} [happily] ¡Hurra! {crab:live dance} Cangrejo chocó las pinzas y bailó. {octopus:live hug} Pulpo abrazó a todos a la vez. {starfish:sparkle} Y Estrella tuvo el cumpleaños más feliz que ha tenido nunca una estrella.

ja-JP.title: 潮だまりの パーティー
ja-JP.text: [excited]きょうは、{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}ヒトデさんのおたんじょうび。潮だまりで、パーティー！{starfish:face happy}{starfish:live jump}{crab:enter}{crab:go to pool}カニくんのプレゼントは、おんがく。{crab:face happy}{sfx:clicks}はさみで、カチカチ、カチカチ。{octopus:enter}{octopus:go to pool}タコくんのプレゼントは、ダンス。うでが八本だから、{octopus:face happy}{octopus:live dance}みーんなと、いっぺんにおどれます！そして、{shrimp:enter}{shrimp:go to pool}エビさんのプレゼントは…なんにもなし。{shrimp:face sad}[nervously]「わたし、なにも、もってこなかったの」 と、ちいさなこえ。[short pause]{starfish:live wave}ヒトデさんは、五本のうでを、ふりふり。[warmly]「きてくれたのが、いちばんのプレゼントよ」 {shrimp:face happy}{shrimp:spin}エビさんは、だれよりもじょうずに、くるくるくるりん！{canvas:confetti 0.8 12s}[happily]ばんざーい！{crab:live dance}カニくんは、カチカチおどり、{octopus:live hug}タコくんは、みんなをいっぺんにぎゅーっ。{starfish:sparkle}ヒトデさんの、いちばんしあわせなおたんじょうび。

de-DE.title: Party im Tümpel
de-DE.text: [excited] {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Der Seestern hatte Geburtstag, und alle kamen zur Party in den Tümpel! {starfish:face happy} {starfish:live jump} {crab:enter} {crab:go to pool} Die Krabbe brachte die Musik mit. {crab:face happy} {sfx:clicks} Klick-klack, klick-klack machten ihre Scheren. {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to pool} Der Krake brachte die Tanzschritte mit. fr-FR.title: La fête dans la mare
fr-FR.text: [excited] C’était un grand jour pour {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Étoile de mer : son anniversaire ! it-IT.title: La festa nella pozza
it-IT.text: [excited] Era il compleanno di {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Stella marina, e tutti sono venuti alla pozza per la festa! {starfish:face happy} {starfish:live jump} {crab:enter} {crab:go to pool} Granchio ha portato la musica. {crab:face happy} {sfx:clicks} Clic clac, clic clac, facevano le sue chele. {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to pool} Polpo ha portato le danze. zh-TW.title: 潮池派對
zh-TW.text: [excited]今天是{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}海星的生日，大家都來潮池開派對囉！{starfish:face happy}{starfish:live jump}{crab:enter}{crab:go to pool}螃蟹負責音樂。{crab:face happy}{sfx:clicks}喀喀、喀喀，牠的鉗子打著拍子。{octopus:enter}{octopus:go to pool}章魚負責跳舞。牠有八隻腳，{octopus:face happy}{octopus:live dance}一次就能跟大家通通一起跳！還有{shrimp:enter}{shrimp:go to pool}小蝦，小蝦帶來了……什麼也沒有。{shrimp:face sad}[nervously]「我沒有帶禮物……」 牠小小聲地說。[short pause]{starfish:live wave}海星揮揮五隻手。[warmly]「你來了呀，」 海星說，「這就是最棒的禮物。」 {shrimp:face happy}{shrimp:spin}於是小蝦轉呀轉、轉呀轉，轉成全場最會轉圈的小舞者。{canvas:confetti 0.8 12s}[happily]耶！{crab:live dance}螃蟹喀喀喀，跳起舞來。{octopus:live hug}章魚一次抱住了所有的朋友。{starfish:sparkle}海星過了一個最最快樂的生日，比哪一顆海星的生日都快樂。

zh-HK.title: 石池派對
zh-HK.text: [excited]今天是{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}海星的生日，大家都來到石池開派對！{starfish:face happy}{starfish:live jump}{crab:enter}{crab:go to pool}螃蟹帶來了音樂。{crab:face happy}{sfx:clicks}牠的鉗子咔嚓、咔嚓、咔嚓、咔嚓地響。{octopus:enter}{octopus:go to pool}八爪魚帶來了跳舞。牠有八隻手，{octopus:face happy}{octopus:live dance}可以同時跟每一個朋友跳！還有{shrimp:enter}{shrimp:go to pool}小蝦，牠帶來了……甚麼也沒有。{shrimp:face sad}[nervously]「我冇帶禮物嚟……」 牠細聲說。[short pause]{starfish:live wave}海星揮動五隻手。[warmly]「你嚟咗，」 海星說，「就係最好嘅禮物喇。」 {shrimp:face happy}{shrimp:spin}於是，小蝦轉呀轉，轉呀轉，是全場轉得最好看的舞蹈家。{canvas:confetti 0.8 12s}[happily]「好嘢！」 {crab:live dance}螃蟹咔嚓咔嚓地跳起舞來。{octopus:live hug}八爪魚一下子抱住所有朋友。{starfish:sparkle}海星過了一個最開心的生日，比哪一隻海星的生日都開心。
